ValidationRule.description: Requires a value for Upsell Customer ID for an Upsell/Lift Opportunity before Stage 5 Signed/PO on Standard Opportunities only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), $RecordType.Name == 'Standard Opportunity' && ISBLANK( Upsell_Customer_ID__c ) && ISPICKVAL(Type, "Up-Sell/Lift") && !(ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM SITAD") && CONTAINS($Label.QTB_SITAD_Countries, QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c)),NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Up-sell opportunities require an Upsell Customer ID
